name: MCP Reference Servers
summary: Reference MCP server implementations maintained by the MCP steering group: Everything, Fetch, Filesystem, Git, Memory, Sequential Thinking and Time.
description: Educational reference implementations demonstrating MCP features and SDK usage; the README warns they are not production-ready. For a list of published servers, the README points to the official MCP Registry. Many older servers (GitHub, Brave Search, GitLab, etc.) were moved to `modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived`.

agent_access.notes: Local stdio servers; run via npx/uvx per each server's README.
